tasks.title: Conversation #114
tasks.transcript:
Man: Are you going to the community cleanup event on Saturday?
Woman: Yes. I think it's a great way to help out and meet new people.
Man: I agree. It starts at 9 a.m. Do you know where we're supposed to meet?
Woman: Yes, we're meeting at the park entrance. Don't forget to bring gloves and trash bags.
Man: Thanks. I'll see you there.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers discussing?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者在讨论什么活动？ 定位原文：Man: Are you going to the community cleanup event on Saturday? 选项分析： A. A charity run 慈善跑。对话中未提及跑步或慈善跑，所以A选项错误。 B. A community cleanup 社区清洁活动。男士明确提到“community cleanup event”，所以B选项正确。 C. A farmers market 农贸市场。对话中未提及农贸市场，所以C选项错误。 D. A festival 节日活动。对话中未提及节日，所以D选项错误。

答案：B 题目问的是：参与者在什么地方集合？ 定位原文：Woman: Yes, we're meeting at the park entrance. 选项分析： A. At a city hall 在市政厅。对话中未提及市政厅，所以A选项错误。 B. At a park entrance 在公园入口。女士明确说在公园入口集合，所以B选项正确。 C. At a community center 在社区中心。对话中未提及社区中心，所以C选项错误。 D. At a school 在学校。对话中未提及学校，所以D选项错误。
